node.title: Re^2: RSA encrypt but no decrypt. What is the problem? (updated)
node.author: Forb
node.doctext: Yes, thanks, I have checked, your code works for me, but it is not convenient for me. In your code, encryption and decryption is done within a single script. In practice, this is not convenient. I would like one script to encrypt the message and another script to decrypt the message. In this case, it is not possible to use Crypt :: OpenSSL :: RSA-> generate_key (1024); in both scripts. The best option is to use the parameters n, e, and d.
